## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(parallel)
library(broom)
library(broom.helpers)

```

## READ IN DATA

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Load complete analytic dataset (HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset) from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd file
complete_subset <- readRDS("NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset20261601.RDS")
dim(complete_subset)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

## DEFINE MODEL EXPOSURES, OUTCOMES, AND COVARIATES

```{r}

## HEALTH ONLY
  ## Define variables
exposure_vars <- c("childrural_democoggen", "SCHLYRS_rev", "LIVEGPAR_R", "CHSMOKE_R")
outcome_vars <- c("GRIM_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")
outcome_vars_gm <- c("globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean")
  ## Define model covariates
covars_health <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate") 


## Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables
  ## Define individual exposures corresponding to the covariates below
exposure_vars1 <- c("childrural_democoggen")
exposure_vars2 <- c("SCHLYRS_rev")
exposure_vars3 <- c("LIVEGPAR_R")
exposure_vars4 <- c("CHSMOKE_R")
  ## Define model covariates
covars1 <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "BEALE_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  
covars2 <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "Parent_Educ", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  
covars3 <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "ATOTB_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  
covars4 <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "smoke_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  

```

## HEALTH ONLY

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_mHm1 <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_mHm1 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_mHm1, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_health)
adjusted_mH_summaries_dfm1 <- models_summarize(var_combinations_mHm1, adjusted_mHm1)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_mHm1, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_m1healthonly20261501.RDS")

## Export the data frame
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mH_summaries_dfm1, "Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_healthonly_AA20261501.xlsx")

```

### Global Methylation

```{r}
## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_gmHm1 <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars_gm)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_gmHm1 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_gmHm1, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_health)
adjusted_gmH_summaries_dfm1 <- models_summarize(var_combinations_gmHm1, adjusted_gmHm1)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_gmHm1, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_gm1healthonly20261501.RDS")

## Export the data frame
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_gmH_summaries_dfm1, "Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_healthonly_GM20261501.xlsx")

```
